column5: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_stock_movement() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _settings public.inventory_settings%ROWTYPE; _item public.items%ROWTYPE; _qty numeric := COALESCE(NEW.quantity, 0); _abs numeric := ABS(_qty); _is_in boolean := _qty > 0; _new_qty numeric; _new_avg numeric; _wh uuid := NEW.warehouse_id; _remaining numeric; _layer record; BEGIN IF NEW.status <> 'posted' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF _qty = 0 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT * INTO _settings FROM public.inventory_settings WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id; SELECT * INTO _item FROM public.items WHERE id = NEW.item_id; IF _item.id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF NOT _is_in AND NOT COALESCE(_settings.negative_stock_allowed, false) THEN IF COALESCE(_item.quantity_on_hand,0) < _abs THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stock insuffisant pour % (dispo=%, demandé=%)', _item.code, _item.quantity_on_hand, _abs; END IF; END IF; IF _is_in AND COALESCE(NEW.unit_cost,0) > 0 THEN _new_qty := COALESCE(_item.quantity_on_hand,0) + _abs; IF _new_qty > 0 THEN _new_avg := ((COALESCE(_item.quantity_on_hand,0) * COALESCE(_item.average_cost,0)) + (_abs * NEW.unit_cost)) / _new_qty; UPDATE public.items SET average_cost = ROUND(_new_avg::numeric, 4) WHERE id = NEW.item_id; END IF; INSERT INTO public.stock_valuation_layers(tenant_id, item_id, warehouse_id, layer_date, qty_in, cost_in, qty_remaining, source_type, source_id) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, NEW.item_id, _wh, COALESCE(NEW.movement_date, CURRENT_DATE), _abs, NEW.unit_cost, _abs, NEW.reference_type, NEW.reference_id); ELSIF NOT _is_in THEN _remaining := _abs; FOR _layer IN SELECT * FROM public.stock_valuation_layers WHERE item_id = NEW.item_id AND qty_remaining > 0 AND (_wh IS NULL OR warehouse_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _wh) ORDER BY layer_date, created_at LOOP EXIT WHEN _remaining <= 0; IF _layer.qty_remaining >= _remaining THEN UPDATE public.stock_valuation_layers SET qty_remaining = qty_remaining - _remaining WHERE id = _layer.id; _remaining := 0; ELSE _remaining := _remaining - _layer.qty_remaining; UPDATE public.stock_valuation_layers SET qty_remaining = 0 WHERE id = _layer.id; END IF; END LOOP; END IF; UPDATE public.items SET quantity_on_hand = COALESCE(quantity_on_hand,0) + _qty WHERE id = NEW.item_id; IF _wh IS NOT NULL THEN INSERT INTO public.item_locations(tenant_id, item_id, warehouse_id, quantity_on_hand) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, NEW.item_id, _wh, _qty) ON CONFLICT (item_id, warehouse_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity_on_hand = public.item_locations.quantity_on_hand + EXCLUDED.quantity_on_hand, updated_at = now(); END IF; IF COALESCE(_settings.low_stock_alerts_enabled, true) THEN PERFORM 1 FROM public.items WHERE id = NEW.item_id AND quantity_on_hand <= COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock,0), reorder_level, 0) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock,0), reorder_level, 0) > 0; IF FOUND THEN PERFORM public.notify_inventory(NEW.tenant_id, 'warning', 'Stock bas — ' || _item.code, 'Article ' || _item.name || ' sous le seuil de réapprovisionnement.', NEW.item_id::text); END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_payroll_run(_run_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _r public.payroll_runs%ROWTYPE; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN IF NOT public.has_hr_perm(auth.uid(), 'approve_payroll_run') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission refusée: rôle Approbateur Paie requis'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _r FROM public.payroll_runs WHERE id = _run_id; IF _r.tenant_id IS NULL OR _r.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cycle introuvable'; END IF; IF _r.status <> 'draft' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Seuls les cycles draft peuvent être approuvés'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.payroll_lines WHERE run_id = _run_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Aucune ligne de paie — générez-les d''abord'; END IF; UPDATE public.payroll_runs SET status='approved', approved_by=auth.uid(), approved_at=now() WHERE id=_run_id; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_procurement_step(_approval_id uuid, _comment text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _a public.procurement_approvals%ROWTYPE; _remaining int; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _docnum text; _perm text; BEGIN SELECT * INTO _a FROM public.procurement_approvals WHERE id = _approval_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Approval not found'; END IF; IF _a.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; IF _a.status <> 'pending' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Already decided'; END IF; _perm := 'approve_l' || _a.level_order::text; IF _a.level_order > 3 THEN _perm := 'approve_l3'; END IF; IF NOT public.has_procurement_perm(auth.uid(), _perm) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: requires role for %', _a.level_label; END IF; UPDATE public.procurement_approvals SET status='approved', decided_by=auth.uid(), decided_at=now(), comment=_comment WHERE id=_approval_id; SELECT count(*) INTO _remaining FROM public.procurement_approvals WHERE doc_type=_a.doc_type AND doc_id=_a.doc_id AND status='pending'; IF _remaining = 0 THEN IF _a.doc_type='PR' THEN UPDATE public.purchase_requisitions SET status='approved', approved_by=auth.uid(), approved_at=now() WHERE id=_a.doc_id RETURNING pr_number INTO _docnum; ELSE UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET status='approved', approved_by=auth.uid() WHERE id=_a.doc_id RETURNING po_number INTO _docnum; END IF; PERFORM public.notify_procurement(_a.tenant_id, 'success', _a.doc_type || ' approuvée', 'Document ' || COALESCE(_docnum,'') || ' entièrement approuvé.', _a.doc_id::text); ELSE PERFORM public.notify_procurement(_a.tenant_id, 'info', _a.level_label || ' approuvé', 'Étape franchie pour ' || _a.doc_type, _a.doc_id::text); END IF; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_compliance_role(_target_user uuid, _role app_role, _action text, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant uuid; _actor uuid := auth.uid(); _conflict public.app_role; BEGIN IF _actor IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authenticated'; END IF; IF NOT (public.has_role(_actor,'admin') OR public.has_role(_actor,'compliance_admin')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: compliance_admin required'; END IF; IF _role NOT IN ('compliance_officer','compliance_auditor','compliance_admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid compliance role: %', _role; END IF; IF _action NOT IN ('grant','revoke') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid action'; END IF; SELECT tenant_id INTO _tenant FROM public.profiles WHERE id = _target_user; IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'target user not found'; END IF; IF _action = 'grant' THEN _conflict := CASE _role WHEN 'compliance_officer' THEN 'compliance_auditor'::public.app_role WHEN 'compliance_auditor' THEN 'compliance_officer'::public.app_role ELSE NULL END; IF _conflict IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _target_user AND role = _conflict ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SoD violation: user already has conflicting role %', _conflict; END IF; INSERT INTO public.user_roles(user_id, role) VALUES (_target_user, _role) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; ELSE DELETE FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _target_user AND role = _role; END IF; INSERT INTO public.compliance_role_audit(tenant_id, actor_user_id, target_user_id, role, action, reason) VALUES (_tenant, _actor, _target_user, _role, _action, _reason); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_expense_role(_target_user uuid, _role app_role, _action text, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _actor uuid := auth.uid(); _tenant uuid; _conflict public.app_role; BEGIN IF _actor IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated'; END IF; IF _action NOT IN ('grant','revoke') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_action'; END IF; IF _role NOT IN ('expense_clerk','expense_approver','expense_controller','expense_admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_role'; END IF; SELECT tenant_id INTO _tenant FROM public.user_role_assignments WHERE user_id = _actor AND role = 'expense_admin' LIMIT 1; IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: expense_admin required'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_role_assignments WHERE user_id = _target_user AND tenant_id = _tenant ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'target_user_not_in_tenant'; END IF; IF _action = 'grant' THEN -- SoD: clerk ⊕ approver mutually exclusive IF _role = 'expense_clerk' THEN _conflict := 'expense_approver'; ELSIF _role = 'expense_approver' THEN _conflict := 'expense_clerk'; ELSE _conflict := NULL; END IF; IF _conflict IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _target_user AND role = _conflict ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'sod_violation: % conflicts with %', _role, _conflict; END IF; INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (_target_user, _role) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role) DO NOTHING; ELSE DELETE FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _target_user AND role = _role; END IF; INSERT INTO public.expense_role_audit (tenant_id, actor_user_id, target_user_id, action, role, reason) VALUES (_tenant, _actor, _target_user, _action, _role, _reason); RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'action', _action, 'role', _role); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_invoice_on_delivery() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _auto boolean; _inv_id uuid; _inv_number text; _subtotal numeric; BEGIN IF NEW.status <> 'completed' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.status = 'completed') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF NEW.ar_invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT auto_invoice_on_delivery INTO _auto FROM public.sales_settings WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id; IF NOT COALESCE(_auto, false) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) INTO _subtotal FROM public.dn_lines WHERE dn_id = NEW.id; IF _subtotal <= 0 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; _inv_number := 'INV-'||to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-'||lpad((floor(random()*99999))::text,5,'0'); INSERT INTO public.ar_invoices(tenant_id, invoice_number, customer_id, invoice_date, due_date, subtotal, tax_amount, total, amount_paid, status, so_id, dn_id, created_by) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, _inv_number, NEW.customer_id, CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE+30, _subtotal, 0, _subtotal, 0, 'sent', NEW.so_id, NEW.id, NEW.created_by) RETURNING id INTO _inv_id; NEW.ar_invoice_id := _inv_id; PERFORM public.notify_sales(NEW.tenant_id, 'success', 'Facture auto-générée', _inv_number || ' depuis ' || NEW.dn_number, _inv_id::text); RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_customer_credit_on_so() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _limit numeric; _outstanding numeric; _name text; BEGIN IF NEW.status <> 'confirmed' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.status = 'confirmed' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT credit_limit, name INTO _limit, _name FROM public.customers WHERE id = NEW.customer_id; IF _limit IS NULL OR _limit <= 0 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total - amount_paid),0) INTO _outstanding FROM public.ar_invoices WHERE customer_id = NEW.customer_id AND status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled'); IF (_outstanding + NEW.total) > _limit THEN PERFORM public.notify_sales(NEW.tenant_id, 'critical', 'Limite de crédit dépassée — ' || COALESCE(_name,''), 'Encours ' || _outstanding::text || ' + commande ' || NEW.total::text || ' > limite ' || _limit::text, NEW.id::text); END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_gl_period(_period text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _id uuid; _unbalanced int; BEGIN IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No tenant'; END IF; IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only administrators can close GL periods'; END IF; -- Refuse close if draft/unbalanced entries exist in the period SELECT count(*) INTO _unbalanced FROM public.journal_entries je WHERE je.tenant_id = _tenant AND to_char(je.entry_date,'YYYY-MM') = _period AND je.status IN ('draft','validated'); IF _unbalanced > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot close % : % entries are still draft/validated', _period, _unbalanced; END IF; INSERT INTO public.period_locks (tenant_id, period, module, status, closed_by, closed_at) VALUES (_tenant, _period, 'GL', 'closed', auth.uid(), now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, period, module) DO UPDATE SET status = 'closed', closed_by = auth.uid(), closed_at = now() RETURNING id INTO _id; RETURN _id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_inventory_period(_period text) RETURNS inventory_period_closes LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant UUID := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _user UUID := auth.uid(); _existing public.inventory_period_closes; _row public.inventory_period_closes; _snapshot JSONB; _total_value NUMERIC; _total_qty NUMERIC; _items_count INTEGER; BEGIN IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'no tenant'; END IF; IF NOT public.has_inventory_perm(_user, 'close') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: requires inventory close permission'; END IF; IF _period !~ '^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid period format, expected YYYY-MM'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _existing FROM public.inventory_period_closes WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND period = _period; IF FOUND THEN INSERT INTO public.inventory_role_audit (tenant_id, target_user_id, role, action, performed_by, comment) VALUES (_tenant, _user, 'inventory_controller', 'period_close_idempotent', _user, _period); RETURN _existing; END IF; SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'item_id', item_id, 'code', code, 'name', name, 'category', category, 'qty', quantity_on_hand, 'unit_cost', unit_cost, 'value', stock_value)), '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(SUM(stock_value), 0), COALESCE(SUM(quantity_on_hand), 0), COUNT(*) INTO _snapshot, _total_value, _total_qty, _items_count FROM public.inventory_slow_moving_view WHERE tenant_id = _tenant; INSERT INTO public.inventory_period_closes (tenant_id, period, closed_by, total_value, total_qty, items_count, snapshot) VALUES (_tenant, _period, _user, _total_value, _total_qty, _items_count, _snapshot) RETURNING * INTO _row; INSERT INTO public.period_locks (tenant_id, period, module, locked_by, locked_at) VALUES (_tenant, _period, 'inventory', _user, now()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO public.inventory_role_audit (tenant_id, target_user_id, role, action, performed_by, comment) VALUES (_tenant, _user, 'inventory_controller', 'period_close', _user, _period); RETURN _row; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_treasury_period(_period text) RETURNS treasury_period_closes LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _user uuid := auth.uid(); _existing public.treasury_period_closes; _row public.treasury_period_closes; _snapshot jsonb; _total_balance numeric := 0; _accounts_count int := 0; _recon_count int := 0; _open_drafts int := 0; _period_start date; _period_end date; BEGIN IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'no tenant'; END IF; IF NOT public.has_treasury_perm(_user, 'close_period') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: requires treasury close permission'; END IF; IF _period !~ '^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid period format, expected YYYY-MM'; END IF; _period_start := to_date(_period || '-01','YYYY-MM-DD'); _period_end := (_period_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; SELECT * INTO _existing FROM public.treasury_period_closes WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND period = _period; IF FOUND THEN INSERT INTO public.treasury_role_audit (tenant_id, actor_id, target_user_id, role, action, comment) VALUES (_tenant, _user, _user, 'treasury_controller'::public.app_role, 'period_close_idempotent', _period); RETURN _existing; END IF; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.period_locks WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND period = _period AND module = 'treasury' AND status = 'closed') THEN INSERT INTO public.treasury_role_audit (tenant_id, actor_id, target_user_id, role, action, comment) VALUES (_tenant, _user, _user, 'treasury_controller'::public.app_role, 'period_close_failed', _period || ' | already_locked'); RAISE EXCEPTION 'period already locked'; END IF; SELECT COUNT(*) INTO _open_drafts FROM public.bank_reconciliations WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND status = 'draft' AND period_end <= _period_end AND period_end >= _period_start; IF _open_drafts > 0 THEN INSERT INTO public.treasury_role_audit (tenant_id, actor_id, target_user_id, role, action, comment) VALUES (_tenant, _user, _user, 'treasury_controller'::public.app_role, 'period_close_failed', _period || ' | unreconciled:' || _open_drafts); RAISE EXCEPTION 'unreconciled: % open reconciliation(s) in period', _open_drafts; END IF; INSERT INTO public.treasury_role_audit (tenant_id, actor_id, target_user_id, role, action, comment) VALUES (_tenant, _user, _user, 'treasury_controller'::public.app_role, 'period_close_started', _period); SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_build_object( 'accounts', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id', id, 'name', name, 'bank_name', bank_name, 'currency', currency, 'balance', balance, 'last_reconciled_at', last_reconciled_at)) FROM public.bank_accounts WHERE tenant_id = _tenant), '[]'::jsonb), 'reconciliations', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id', id, 'bank_account_id', bank_account_id, 'period_start', period_start, 'period_end', period_end, 'status', status, 'ending_balance', ending_balance)) FROM public.bank_reconciliations WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND period_end >= _period_start AND period_end <= _period_end), '[]'::jsonb), 'period_start', _period_start, 'period_end', _period_end ), '{}'::jsonb) INTO _snapshot; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0), COUNT(*) INTO _total_balance, _accounts_count FROM public.bank_accounts WHERE tenant_id = _tenant; SELECT COUNT(*) INTO _recon_count FROM public.bank_reconciliations WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND period_end >= _period_start AND period_end <= _period_end; INSERT INTO public.treasury_period_closes (tenant_id, period, status, total_balance, accounts_count, reconciliations_count, snapshot, closed_by) VALUES (_tenant, _period, 'completed', _total_balance, _accounts_count, _recon_count, _snapshot, _user) RETURNING * INTO _row; INSERT INTO public.period_locks (tenant_id, period, module, status, closed_by, closed_at) VALUES (_tenant, _period, 'treasury', 'closed', _user, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, period, module) DO UPDATE SET status='closed', closed_by = EXCLUDED.closed_by, closed_at = EXCLUDED.closed_at; INSERT INTO public.treasury_role_audit (tenant_id, actor_id, target_user_id, role, action, comment) VALUES (_tenant, _user, _user, 'treasury_controller'::public.app_role, 'period_close_completed', _period); RETURN _row; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commit_budget_on_po() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _budget_id uuid; _period text; BEGIN IF NEW.status NOT IN ('approved','ordered') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status = NEW.status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; _period := to_char(NEW.order_date, 'YYYY-MM'); SELECT id INTO _budget_id FROM public.budgets WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND status = 'approved' AND fiscal_year = to_char(NEW.order_date, 'YYYY') LIMIT 1; IF _budget_id IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE public.budget_lines SET actual_amount = COALESCE(actual_amount,0) + NEW.total WHERE budget_id = _budget_id AND period = _period; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_dn_line_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.total := ROUND((COALESCE(NEW.quantity,0)*COALESCE(NEW.unit_price,0))::numeric,2); RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_payroll_line(_employee_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(gross numeric, deductions numeric, taxes numeric, net numeric) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _base numeric; BEGIN SELECT base_salary INTO _base FROM public.employees WHERE id = _employee_id; IF _base IS NULL THEN _base := 0; END IF; gross := ROUND(_base, 2); deductions := ROUND(_base * 0.063, 2); taxes := ROUND((_base - (_base * 0.063)) * 0.10, 2); net := ROUND(gross - deductions - taxes, 2); RETURN NEXT; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_po_line_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.total := ROUND((COALESCE(NEW.quantity,0) * COALESCE(NEW.unit_cost,0))::numeric, 2); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_quote_line_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.total := ROUND((COALESCE(NEW.quantity,0)*COALESCE(NEW.unit_price,0))::numeric,2); RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_req_line_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.total := ROUND((COALESCE(NEW.quantity,0) * COALESCE(NEW.estimated_unit_cost,0))::numeric, 2); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_so_line_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.total := ROUND((COALESCE(NEW.quantity,0)*COALESCE(NEW.unit_price,0))::numeric,2); RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_stock_movement_value() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF NEW.unit_cost IS NULL THEN NEW.unit_cost := 0; END IF; NEW.total_value := ROUND((ABS(COALESCE(NEW.quantity,0)) * COALESCE(NEW.unit_cost,0))::numeric, 2); RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_quote_to_so(_quote_id uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _q public.quotations%ROWTYPE; _so_id uuid; _so_number text; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN IF NOT public.has_sales_perm(auth.uid(),'confirm') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _q FROM public.quotations WHERE id=_quote_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quote not found'; END IF; IF _q.tenant_id<>_tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; IF _q.status NOT IN ('accepted','sent','draft') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quote status invalid: %', _q.status; END IF; _so_number := 'SO-'||to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-'||lpad((floor(random()*9999))::text,4,'0'); INSERT INTO public.sales_orders(tenant_id, so_number, quotation_id, customer_id, order_date, total, status, created_by) VALUES (_q.tenant_id, _so_number, _q.id, _q.customer_id, CURRENT_DATE, COALESCE(_q.total,0), 'draft', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _so_id; INSERT INTO public.so_lines(so_id, item_id, description, quantity, unit_price, total) SELECT _so_id, ql.item_id, ql.description, ql.quantity, ql.unit_price, ql.total FROM public.quote_lines ql WHERE ql.quotation_id=_quote_id; UPDATE public.quotations SET status='converted' WHERE id=_quote_id; PERFORM public.notify_sales(_q.tenant_id,'info','Quote → SO',_q.quote_number||' → '||_so_number,_so_id::text); RETURN _so_id; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_so(_so_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _s public.sales_orders%ROWTYPE; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN IF NOT public.has_sales_perm(auth.uid(),'confirm') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _s FROM public.sales_orders WHERE id=_so_id; IF _s.tenant_id<>_tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; UPDATE public.sales_orders SET status='confirmed' WHERE id=_so_id; PERFORM public.notify_sales(_s.tenant_id,'success','SO confirmé',_s.so_number,_so_id::text); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.convert_opportunity_to_quote(_opp_id uuid, _customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _valid_until date DEFAULT NULL::date) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _opp public.crm_opportunities%ROWTYPE; _tenant UUID := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _customer UUID; _quote_id UUID; _qnum TEXT; _is_manager BOOLEAN; BEGIN IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_tenant'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _opp FROM public.crm_opportunities WHERE id = _opp_id AND tenant_id = _tenant; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'opportunity_not_found'; END IF; -- Idempotent: already converted IF _opp.converted_quotation_id IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN _opp.converted_quotation_id; END IF; IF _opp.stage <> 'won' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'opportunity_not_won'; END IF; -- RBAC: require crm_manager or crm_admin SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id = auth.uid() AND ur.tenant_id = _tenant AND ur.role IN ('crm_manager','crm_admin') ) INTO _is_manager; IF NOT _is_manager THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_role'; END IF; _customer := COALESCE(_customer_id, _opp.customer_id); IF _customer IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'customer_required'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id = _customer AND tenant_id = _tenant) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'customer_invalid_tenant'; END IF; _qnum := 'Q-' || to_char(now(), 'YYYYMM') || '-' || substr(replace(_opp_id::text, '-', ''), 1, 8); INSERT INTO public.quotations (tenant_id, quote_number, customer_id, quote_date, valid_until, total, status, created_by) VALUES (_tenant, _qnum, _customer, CURRENT_DATE, COALESCE(_valid_until, CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days'), COALESCE(_opp.amount, 0), 'draft', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _quote_id; UPDATE public.crm_opportunities SET converted_quotation_id = _quote_id, customer_id = _customer, status = 'closed', updated_at = now() WHERE id = _opp_id; INSERT INTO public.crm_activities (tenant_id, opportunity_id, contact_id, type, subject, notes, created_by) VALUES (_tenant, _opp_id, _opp.contact_id, 'conversion', 'Converti en devis ' || _qnum, 'Quotation ' || _quote_id::text || ' · Montant ' || COALESCE(_opp.amount,0)::text || ' ' || _opp.currency, auth.uid()); RETURN _quote_id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.convert_pr_to_po(_pr_id uuid, _supplier_id uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _pr public.purchase_requisitions%ROWTYPE; _po_id uuid; _po_number text; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN IF NOT public.has_procurement_perm(auth.uid(), 'convert') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: PR→PO conversion requires Controller or L2+ role'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _pr FROM public.purchase_requisitions WHERE id=_pr_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PR not found'; END IF; IF _pr.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; IF _pr.status NOT IN ('approved') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PR must be approved (status=%)', _pr.status; END IF; IF _pr.po_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PR already converted to PO'; END IF; _po_number := 'PO-' || to_char(now(),'YYYY') || '-' || lpad((floor(random()*9999))::text, 4, '0'); INSERT INTO public.purchase_orders (tenant_id, po_number, supplier_id, order_date, total, status, created_by) VALUES (_pr.tenant_id, _po_number, _supplier_id, CURRENT_DATE, COALESCE(_pr.estimated_total,0), 'draft', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _po_id; INSERT INTO public.po_lines (po_id, item_id, description, quantity, unit_cost, total) SELECT _po_id, rl.item_id, rl.description, rl.quantity, rl.estimated_unit_cost, rl.total FROM public.requisition_lines rl WHERE rl.requisition_id = _pr_id; UPDATE public.purchase_requisitions SET po_id=_po_id, status='converted' WHERE id=_pr_id; PERFORM public.notify_procurement(_pr.tenant_id, 'info', 'PR → PO converti', _pr.pr_number || ' → ' || _po_number, _po_id::text); RETURN _po_id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.convert_quote_to_so(_quote_id uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _q public.quotations%ROWTYPE; _so_id uuid; _so_number text; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _opp_id uuid; _already boolean := false; BEGIN IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_tenant'; END IF; IF NOT public.has_sales_perm(auth.uid(),'confirm') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_role'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _q FROM public.quotations WHERE id=_quote_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'quote_not_found'; END IF; IF _q.tenant_id<>_tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_mismatch'; END IF; SELECT id INTO _so_id FROM public.sales_orders WHERE quotation_id=_quote_id LIMIT 1; IF _so_id IS NOT NULL THEN _already := true; ELSE IF _q.status NOT IN ('accepted','sent','draft') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'quote_status_invalid'; END IF; _so_number := 'SO-'||to_char(now(),'YYYYMM')||'-'||substr(replace(_quote_id::text,'-',''),1,8); INSERT INTO public.sales_orders(tenant_id, so_number, quotation_id, customer_id, order_date, total, status, created_by) VALUES (_tenant, _so_number, _q.id, _q.customer_id, CURRENT_DATE, COALESCE(_q.total,0), 'draft', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _so_id; INSERT INTO public.so_lines(so_id, item_id, description, quantity, unit_price, total) SELECT _so_id, ql.item_id, ql.description, ql.quantity, ql.unit_price, ql.total FROM public.quote_lines ql WHERE ql.quotation_id=_quote_id; UPDATE public.quotations SET status='converted' WHERE id=_quote_id; END IF; SELECT id INTO _opp_id FROM public.crm_opportunities WHERE converted_quotation_id=_quote_id LIMIT 1; IF _opp_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT _already THEN INSERT INTO public.crm_activities(tenant_id, opportunity_id, type, subject, notes, created_by, completed_at) VALUES (_tenant, _opp_id, 'so_conversion', 'Devis converti en bon de commande', 'quote_id='||_quote_id::text||' so_id='||_so_id::text, auth.uid(), now()); END IF; RETURN _so_id; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_tenant_for_user(_tenant_name text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant_id uuid; _user_id uuid := auth.uid(); BEGIN -- Create tenant INSERT INTO public.tenants (name) VALUES (_tenant_name) RETURNING id INTO _tenant_id; -- Link profile to tenant UPDATE public.profiles SET tenant_id = _tenant_id WHERE id = _user_id; -- Assign admin role INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role, tenant_id) VALUES (_user_id, 'admin', _tenant_id); RETURN _tenant_id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_audit_stage_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.stage IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.stage THEN INSERT INTO public.crm_activities(tenant_id, opportunity_id, contact_id, type, subject, completed_at, created_by) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, NEW.id, NEW.contact_id, 'stage_change', 'Étape : ' || OLD.stage || ' → ' || NEW.stage, now(), auth.uid()); END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_balanced_entry() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _dr numeric; _cr numeric; _cnt int; BEGIN IF NEW.status <> 'posted' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status = 'posted' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit),0), COALESCE(SUM(credit),0), COUNT(*) INTO _dr, _cr, _cnt FROM public.journal_lines WHERE entry_id = NEW.id; IF _cnt = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'JE %: cannot post empty entry', NEW.entry_number; END IF; IF ROUND(_dr,2) <> ROUND(_cr,2) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'JE %: unbalanced (DR=% CR=%)', NEW.entry_number, _dr, _cr; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_inventory_period_lock() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _period text; _date date; _locked boolean; BEGIN _date := COALESCE(NEW.movement_date, CURRENT_DATE); _period := to_char(_date, 'YYYY-MM'); SELECT (status='closed') INTO _locked FROM public.period_locks WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND module = 'Inventory' AND period = _period LIMIT 1; IF COALESCE(_locked,false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Période stock % verrouillée', _period; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_period_lock() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _period text; _locked boolean; BEGIN -- Only check when the entry is or becomes posted IF NEW.status NOT IN ('posted','reversed') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; _period := to_char(NEW.entry_date, 'YYYY-MM'); SELECT (status = 'closed') INTO _locked FROM public.period_locks WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND module = 'GL' AND period = _period LIMIT 1; IF COALESCE(_locked, false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'GL period % is closed — entry % cannot be posted/modified', _period, NEW.entry_number; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_sales_period_lock() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _period text; _date date; _locked boolean; BEGIN _date := CASE TG_TABLE_NAME WHEN 'quotations' THEN NEW.quote_date WHEN 'sales_orders' THEN NEW.order_date WHEN 'delivery_notes' THEN NEW.delivery_date END; IF _date IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; _period := to_char(_date, 'YYYY-MM'); SELECT (status='closed') INTO _locked FROM public.period_locks WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND module = 'Sales' AND period = _period LIMIT 1; IF COALESCE(_locked, false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sales period % is closed — operation refused on %', _period, TG_TABLE_NAME; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_payroll_lines(_run_id uuid) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _run public.payroll_runs%ROWTYPE; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _count integer := 0; BEGIN IF NOT public.has_hr_perm(auth.uid(), 'create_payroll_run') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission refusée: rôle Saisie RH requis'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _run FROM public.payroll_runs WHERE id = _run_id; IF _run.tenant_id IS NULL OR _run.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cycle introuvable'; END IF; IF _run.status <> 'draft' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cycle non modifiable (statut %)', _run.status; END IF; DELETE FROM public.payroll_lines WHERE run_id = _run_id; INSERT INTO public.payroll_lines (tenant_id, run_id, employee_id, gross, deductions, taxes, net) SELECT _run.tenant_id, _run_id, e.id, c.gross, c.deductions, c.taxes, c.net FROM public.employees e CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.compute_payroll_line(e.id) c WHERE e.tenant_id = _run.tenant_id AND e.status = 'active'; GET DIAGNOSTICS _count = ROW_COUNT; UPDATE public.payroll_runs SET gross_total = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(gross) FROM public.payroll_lines WHERE run_id = _run_id),0), net_total = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net) FROM public.payroll_lines WHERE run_id = _run_id),0), employee_count = _count WHERE id = _run_id; RETURN _count; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_accessible_tenants() RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, currency text) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.name, t.currency FROM public.tenants t WHERE t.id IN ( SELECT tenant_id FROM public.user_role_assignments WHERE user_id = auth.uid() UNION SELECT tenant_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() ) ORDER BY t.name; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_consolidated_cfo_kpis(_tenant_ids uuid[]) RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id uuid, tenant_name text, currency text, cash_on_hand numeric, ar_outstanding numeric, ap_outstanding numeric, ar_overdue numeric, ap_overdue numeric, ar_overdue_count integer, ap_overdue_count integer, open_projects integer, open_risks_high integer, unmatched_recon_count integer) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE v_allowed uuid[]; BEGIN SELECT array_agg(t.id) INTO v_allowed FROM public.get_accessible_tenants() t WHERE t.id = ANY (_tenant_ids); IF v_allowed IS NULL OR array_length(v_allowed, 1) = 0 THEN RETURN; END IF; RETURN QUERY WITH base AS ( SELECT t.id AS tid, t.name AS tname, t.currency AS tcur FROM public.tenants t WHERE t.id = ANY (v_allowed) ), ar AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id AS tid, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status <> 'paid' THEN i.total - i.amount_paid END), 0) AS outstanding, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status <> 'paid' AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN i.total - i.amount_paid END), 0) AS overdue, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status <> 'paid' AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_count FROM public.ar_invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = ANY (v_allowed) GROUP BY i.tenant_id ), ap AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id AS tid, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status <> 'paid' THEN i.total - i.amount_paid END), 0) AS outstanding, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status <> 'paid' AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN i.total - i.amount_paid END), 0) AS overdue, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status <> 'paid' AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_count FROM public.ap_invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = ANY (v_allowed) GROUP BY i.tenant_id ), cash AS ( SELECT a.tenant_id AS tid, COALESCE(SUM(a.balance), 0) AS bal FROM public.bank_accounts a WHERE a.tenant_id = ANY (v_allowed) GROUP BY a.tenant_id ), proj AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id AS tid, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM public.projects p WHERE p.tenant_id = ANY (v_allowed) AND p.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.tenant_id ), rsk AS ( SELECT r.tenant_id AS tid, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM public.risk_register r WHERE r.tenant_id = ANY (v_allowed) AND r.risk_score >= 9 AND r.status <> 'closed' GROUP BY r.tenant_id ), rec AS ( SELECT r.tenant_id AS tid, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM public.bank_reconciliations r WHERE r.tenant_id = ANY (v_allowed) AND r.status = 'draft' GROUP BY r.tenant_id ) SELECT b.tid, b.tname, b.tcur, COALESCE(cash.bal, 0), COALESCE(ar.outstanding, 0), COALESCE(ap.outstanding, 0), COALESCE(ar.overdue, 0), COALESCE(ap.overdue, 0), COALESCE(ar.overdue_count, 0)::int, COALESCE(ap.overdue_count, 0)::int, COALESCE(proj.n, 0), COALESCE(rsk.n, 0), COALESCE(rec.n, 0) FROM base b LEFT JOIN cash ON cash.tid=b.tid LEFT JOIN ar ON ar.tid=b.tid LEFT JOIN ap ON ap.tid=b.tid LEFT JOIN proj ON proj.tid=b.tid LEFT JOIN rsk ON rsk.tid=b.tid LEFT JOIN rec ON rec.tid=b.tid ORDER BY b.tname; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_consolidated_cfo_trends(_tenant_ids uuid[], _months integer DEFAULT 12) RETURNS TABLE(month text, revenue numeric, expenses numeric, net_profit numeric, cash_balance numeric) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF; IF _months IS NULL OR _months NOT IN (3, 6, 12) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Period must be 3, 6 or 12 months' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF; RETURN QUERY WITH allowed AS ( SELECT a.id FROM public.get_accessible_tenants() a WHERE a.id = ANY(_tenant_ids) ), periods AS ( SELECT s::date AS start_date, LEAST((s + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date, CURRENT_DATE) AS end_date FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - make_interval(months => _months - 1), date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE), interval '1 month') s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM allowed) ), receipts AS ( SELECT to_char(p.payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS key, COALESCE(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'ar_receipt'), 0) AS income, COALESCE(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'ap_payment'), 0) AS spending FROM public.payments p JOIN allowed a ON a.id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.payment_date >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - make_interval(months => _months - 1))::date AND p.payment_date <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY to_char(p.payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') ) SELECT to_char(m.start_date, 'YYYY-MM'), COALESCE(r.income, 0), COALESCE(r.spending, 0), COALESCE(r.income, 0) - COALESCE(r.spending, 0), CASE WHEN count(b.id) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN m.start_date = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date THEN sum(b.balance) WHEN count(h.closing_balance) = count(b.id) THEN sum(h.closing_balance) ELSE NULL END FROM periods m LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.key = to_char(m.start_date, 'YYYY-MM') LEFT JOIN public.bank_accounts b ON b.tenant_id IN (SELECT a.id FROM allowed a) AND b.is_active = true AND b.currency = 'XOF' AND b.created_at::date <= m.end_date LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT bs.closing_balance FROM public.bank_statements bs WHERE bs.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND bs.bank_account_id = b.id AND bs.period_end = m.end_date AND bs.period_start <= m.start_date AND bs.status = 'imported' ORDER BY bs.created_at DESC, bs.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) h ON true GROUP BY m.start_date, r.income, r.spending ORDER BY m.start_date; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_tenant_id(_user_id uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT tenant_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = _user_id $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_ap_payment() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _approval text; BEGIN IF NEW.payment_type <> 'ap_payment' OR NEW.ap_invoice_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; SELECT approval_status INTO _approval FROM public.ap_invoices WHERE id = NEW.ap_invoice_id; IF _approval IS NULL OR _approval <> 'approved' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot pay AP invoice %: approval_status must be approved (got %)', NEW.ap_invoice_id, _approval; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_payroll_run_lock() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status='posted' AND NEW.status <> 'posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Un cycle comptabilisé ne peut être modifié'; END IF; IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND OLD.status='posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Un cycle comptabilisé ne peut être supprimé'; END IF; RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_po_approval() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _pr_status text; BEGIN IF NEW.status IN ('approved','ordered') AND (TG_OP='INSERT' OR OLD.status <> NEW.status) THEN SELECT status INTO _pr_status FROM public.purchase_requisitions WHERE po_id = NEW.id LIMIT 1; IF _pr_status IS NOT NULL AND _pr_status NOT IN ('approved','converted') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PO %: linked PR must be approved first (current: %)', NEW.po_number, _pr_status; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name) VALUES (NEW.id, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', '')); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_crm_perm(_user_id uuid, _action text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT CASE WHEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'admin'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_admin'::public.app_role) THEN TRUE ELSE CASE _action WHEN 'view' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_agent'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_auditor'::public.app_role) WHEN 'create' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_agent'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'edit' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_agent'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'delete' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'approve_discount' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'convert' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'export' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_auditor'::public.app_role) WHEN 'view_sensitive' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_auditor'::public.app_role) WHEN 'audit' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'crm_auditor'::public.app_role) ELSE FALSE END END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_hr_perm(_user_id uuid, _action text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT public.has_role(_user_id, 'admin'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_admin'::public.app_role) OR CASE _action WHEN 'create_payroll_run' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_clerk'::public.app_role) WHEN 'approve_payroll_run' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_approver'::public.app_role) WHEN 'execute_payroll' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'payroll_officer'::public.app_role) WHEN 'audit_payroll' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_auditor'::public.app_role) WHEN 'export' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_approver'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'payroll_officer'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_auditor'::public.app_role) WHEN 'view_sensitive' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_approver'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'payroll_officer'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'hr_auditor'::public.app_role) ELSE false END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_inventory_perm(_user_id uuid, _action text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT public.has_role(_user_id, 'admin'::public.app_role) OR CASE _action WHEN 'move' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'adjust' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'transfer' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'count' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'post_count' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'inventory_controller'::public.app_role) ELSE false END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_procurement_perm(_user_id uuid, _action text, _level integer DEFAULT NULL::integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT public.has_role(_user_id, 'admin'::public.app_role) OR CASE _action WHEN 'approve_l1' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l1'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l2'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l3'::public.app_role) WHEN 'approve_l2' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l2'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l3'::public.app_role) WHEN 'approve_l3' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l3'::public.app_role) WHEN 'convert' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_controller'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l2'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_l3'::public.app_role) WHEN '3wm' THEN public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_3wm_approver'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'procurement_controller'::public.app_role) ELSE false END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = _role ) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_sales_perm(_user_id uuid, _action text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT public.has_role(_user_id,'admin'::public.app_role) OR CASE _action WHEN 'create' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_rep'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'confirm' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'deliver' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_rep'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'invoice' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'sales_controller'::public.app_role) ELSE false END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_treasury_perm(_user_id uuid, _action text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT public.has_role(_user_id, 'admin'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id, 'cash_admin'::public.app_role) OR CASE _action WHEN 'create_txn' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'import_statement' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'match' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'validate_recon' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'edit_forecast' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'manage_accounts' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'export' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'view_sensitive' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_clerk'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_controller'::public.app_role) WHEN 'close_period' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_controller'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) WHEN 'audit' THEN public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_controller'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(_user_id,'treasury_manager'::public.app_role) ELSE false END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.invoice_from_delivery(_dn_id uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _dn public.delivery_notes%ROWTYPE; _inv_id uuid; _inv_number text; _subtotal numeric; _tax numeric := 0; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN IF NOT public.has_sales_perm(auth.uid(),'invoice') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _dn FROM public.delivery_notes WHERE id=_dn_id; IF _dn.tenant_id<>_tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; IF _dn.ar_invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Already invoiced'; END IF; IF _dn.status<>'completed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DN not completed'; END IF; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) INTO _subtotal FROM public.dn_lines WHERE dn_id=_dn_id; _inv_number := 'INV-'||to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-'||lpad((floor(random()*9999))::text,4,'0'); INSERT INTO public.ar_invoices(tenant_id, invoice_number, customer_id, invoice_date, due_date, subtotal, tax_amount, total, amount_paid, status, so_id, dn_id, created_by) VALUES (_tenant, _inv_number, _dn.customer_id, CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE+30, _subtotal, _tax, _subtotal+_tax, 0, 'sent', _dn.so_id, _dn_id, auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _inv_id; UPDATE public.delivery_notes SET ar_invoice_id=_inv_id WHERE id=_dn_id; PERFORM public.notify_sales(_tenant,'success','Facture créée',_inv_number||' depuis '||_dn.dn_number,_inv_id::text); RETURN _inv_id; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.join_tenant(_tenant_name text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant_id uuid; _user_id uuid := auth.uid(); BEGIN -- Find tenant by name (case insensitive) SELECT id INTO _tenant_id FROM public.tenants WHERE lower(name) = lower(_tenant_name) LIMIT 1; IF _tenant_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant not found'; END IF; -- Link profile to tenant UPDATE public.profiles SET tenant_id = _tenant_id WHERE id = _user_id; -- Assign viewer role INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role, tenant_id) VALUES (_user_id, 'viewer', _tenant_id); RETURN _tenant_id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_crm_export(_opportunity_id uuid, _format text, _kind text, _record_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_tenant'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.crm_activities(tenant_id, opportunity_id, type, subject, notes, created_by, completed_at) VALUES (_tenant, _opportunity_id, 'export', 'Export '||upper(_format)||' — '||_kind, CASE WHEN _record_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'record_id='||_record_id::text ELSE NULL END, auth.uid(), now()); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_journal_entry_audit() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _action text; _details text; _batch_id text; _prev_hash text; _new_hash text; BEGIN -- Determine action IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN _action := 'Created'; _details := 'Journal entry created: ' || NEW.entry_number || COALESCE(' — ' || NEW.description, ''); ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN IF OLD.status <> NEW.status THEN CASE NEW.status WHEN 'posted' THEN _action := 'Posted'; _details := 'Posted to GL by ' || COALESCE(NEW.posted_by::text, 'System'); WHEN 'validated' THEN _action := 'Approved'; _details := 'Approved for posting'; WHEN 'rejected' THEN _action := 'Rejected'; _details := 'Entry rejected'; WHEN 'cancelled' THEN _action := 'Cancelled'; _details := 'Entry cancelled'; WHEN 'reversed' THEN _action := 'Reversed'; _details := 'Entry reversed — compensating entry created'; ELSE _action := 'Updated'; _details := 'Status changed from ' || OLD.status || ' to ' || NEW.status; END CASE; ELSE _action := 'Updated'; _details := 'Entry modified: ' || NEW.entry_number; END IF; END IF; -- Build batch ID from source + date _batch_id := 'GLB-' || UPPER(COALESCE( CASE NEW.source WHEN 'ar_receipt' THEN 'AR' WHEN 'ar_invoice' THEN 'AR' WHEN 'ap_payment' THEN 'AP' WHEN 'ap_invoice' THEN 'AP' WHEN 'manual' THEN 'GL' ELSE UPPER(LEFT(NEW.source, 4)) END, 'GL')) || '-' || to_char(NEW.entry_date, 'YYYYMMDD'); -- Get previous hash for chain integrity SELECT COALESCE(hash, '00000000') INTO _prev_hash FROM public.gl_audit_logs WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; IF _prev_hash IS NULL THEN _prev_hash := '00000000'; END IF; -- Simple hash (MD5 truncated) _new_hash := UPPER(LEFT(md5(_prev_hash || _action || NEW.id::text || now()::text), 8)); INSERT INTO public.gl_audit_logs (tenant_id, batch_id, entry_id, action, user_name, details, hash, prev_hash) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, _batch_id, NEW.id, _action, COALESCE(NEW.created_by::text, 'System'), _details, _new_hash, _prev_hash); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.on_gr_completed() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF NEW.status = 'completed' AND (OLD.status IS NULL OR OLD.status <> 'completed') THEN -- Update PO status to received UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET status = 'received' WHERE id = NEW.po_id AND status = 'approved'; -- Update stock quantities for received items INSERT INTO public.stock_movements (tenant_id, item_id, movement_type, quantity, reference_type, reference_id, created_by) SELECT NEW.tenant_id, gl.item_id, 'receipt', gl.quantity_received, 'goods_receipt', NEW.id, NEW.received_by FROM public.gr_lines gl WHERE gl.gr_id = NEW.id AND gl.item_id IS NOT NULL; -- Update item quantities UPDATE public.items i SET quantity_on_hand = i.quantity_on_hand + gl.quantity_received FROM public.gr_lines gl WHERE gl.gr_id = NEW.id AND gl.item_id = i.id; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.on_stock_movement_je() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _settings public.inventory_settings%ROWTYPE; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.post_asset_disposal(_asset_id uuid, _disposal_date date, _disposal_type text, _sale_price numeric, _notes text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE v_asset RECORD; v_cat RECORD; v_disposal_id uuid; v_je_id uuid; v_gain_loss numeric; v_tenant uuid; BEGIN SELECT * INTO v_asset FROM public.assets WHERE id = _asset_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Asset not found'; END IF; v_tenant := v_asset.tenant_id; IF v_asset.status = 'disposed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Asset already disposed'; END IF; SELECT * INTO v_cat FROM public.asset_categories WHERE id = v_asset.category_id; v_gain_loss := _sale_price - v_asset.net_book_value; -- JE: DR cash _sale_price, DR accumulated_depreciation, CR asset gross, CR/DR gain/loss INSERT INTO public.journal_entries (tenant_id, entry_date, reference, description, status, created_by) VALUES (v_tenant, _disposal_date, 'DISP-' || v_asset.asset_code, 'Cession ' || v_asset.name, 'posted', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO v_je_id; INSERT INTO public.asset_disposals (tenant_id, asset_id, disposal_date, disposal_type, sale_price, net_book_value_at_disposal, gain_loss, journal_entry_id, notes) VALUES (v_tenant, _asset_id, _disposal_date, _disposal_type, _sale_price, v_asset.net_book_value, v_gain_loss, v_je_id, _notes) RETURNING id INTO v_disposal_id; UPDATE public.assets SET status = 'disposed', disposal_date = _disposal_date, disposal_amount = _sale_price WHERE id = _asset_id; RETURN v_disposal_id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.post_delivery(_so_id uuid, _lines jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _s public.sales_orders%ROWTYPE;
