CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.post_inventory_count(_count_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _c public.inventory_counts%ROWTYPE; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _line record; BEGIN IF NOT public.has_inventory_perm(auth.uid(), 'post_count') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _c FROM public.inventory_counts WHERE id = _count_id; IF _c.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; IF _c.status = 'posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Inventaire déjà validé'; END IF; FOR _line IN SELECT l.*, i.average_cost FROM public.inventory_count_lines l JOIN public.items i ON i.id = l.item_id WHERE l.count_id = _count_id AND l.counted_qty <> l.expected_qty LOOP INSERT INTO public.stock_movements(tenant_id, item_id, movement_type, quantity, unit_cost, warehouse_id, reference_type, reference_id, created_by, status) VALUES (_tenant, _line.item_id, 'adjustment', _line.counted_qty - _line.expected_qty, COALESCE(_line.unit_cost, _line.average_cost, 0), _c.warehouse_id, 'inventory_count', _count_id, auth.uid(), 'posted'); END LOOP; UPDATE public.inventory_counts SET status='posted', posted_by=auth.uid(), posted_at=now() WHERE id=_count_id; PERFORM public.notify_inventory(_tenant, 'success', 'Inventaire validé', _c.count_number, _count_id::text); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.post_monthly_depreciation(_tenant_id uuid, _period date) RETURNS TABLE(asset_id uuid, amount numeric, journal_entry_id uuid) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE r RECORD; v_monthly numeric; v_remaining numeric; v_je_id uuid; v_period date := date_trunc('month', _period)::date; BEGIN -- Reject if period locked IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.period_locks WHERE tenant_id = _tenant_id AND period_date = v_period AND module IN ('GL','FIXED_ASSETS') AND is_locked = true ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Period % is locked for tenant %', v_period, _tenant_id; END IF; FOR r IN SELECT a.*, c.gl_depreciation_account_id, c.gl_expense_account_id FROM public.assets a LEFT JOIN public.asset_categories c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND a.status = 'in_service' AND a.acquisition_date <= v_period AND a.net_book_value > a.salvage_value AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.depreciation_entries d WHERE d.asset_id = a.id AND d.period_date = v_period ) LOOP -- Linear monthly depreciation v_monthly := round((r.acquisition_cost - r.salvage_value) / GREATEST(r.useful_life_months,1), 2); v_remaining := r.net_book_value - r.salvage_value; IF v_monthly > v_remaining THEN v_monthly := v_remaining; END IF; IF v_monthly <= 0 THEN CONTINUE; END IF; -- Create journal entry (header) INSERT INTO public.journal_entries (tenant_id, entry_date, reference, description, status, created_by) VALUES (_tenant_id, v_period, 'DEP-' || to_char(v_period,'YYYYMM') || '-' || r.asset_code, 'Dotation amortissement ' || r.name, 'posted', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO v_je_id; -- DR expense / CR accumulated depreciation IF r.gl_expense_account_id IS NOT NULL AND r.gl_depreciation_account_id IS NOT NULL THEN INSERT INTO public.journal_lines (journal_entry_id, account_id, debit, credit, description) VALUES (v_je_id, r.gl_expense_account_id, v_monthly, 0, 'Dotation ' || r.asset_code), (v_je_id, r.gl_depreciation_account_id, 0, v_monthly, 'Cumul amort ' || r.asset_code); END IF; -- Update asset UPDATE public.assets SET accumulated_depreciation = accumulated_depreciation + v_monthly, net_book_value = net_book_value - v_monthly WHERE id = r.id; -- Insert depreciation entry INSERT INTO public.depreciation_entries (asset_id, period_date, amount, accumulated, net_book_value, journal_entry_id) VALUES (r.id, v_period, v_monthly, r.accumulated_depreciation + v_monthly, r.net_book_value - v_monthly, v_je_id); asset_id := r.id; amount := v_monthly; journal_entry_id := v_je_id; RETURN NEXT; END LOOP; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.post_payroll_run(_run_id uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _r public.payroll_runs%ROWTYPE; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _entry_id uuid; _entry_number text; _acc_salaires uuid; _acc_charges uuid; _acc_personnel uuid; _acc_cnps uuid; _acc_etat uuid; _gross numeric; _ded numeric; _tax numeric; _net numeric; _patronal numeric; BEGIN IF NOT public.has_hr_perm(auth.uid(), 'execute_payroll') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission refusée: rôle Officier de Paie requis'; END IF; SELECT * INTO _r FROM public.payroll_runs WHERE id=_run_id; IF _r.tenant_id IS NULL OR _r.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cycle introuvable'; END IF; IF _r.status = 'posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cycle déjà comptabilisé'; END IF; IF _r.status <> 'approved' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Le cycle doit être approuvé avant comptabilisation'; END IF; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gross),0), COALESCE(SUM(deductions),0), COALESCE(SUM(taxes),0), COALESCE(SUM(net),0) INTO _gross, _ded, _tax, _net FROM public.payroll_lines WHERE run_id=_run_id; IF _gross <= 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cycle vide — aucune ligne à comptabiliser'; END IF; _patronal := ROUND(_gross * 0.164, 2); SELECT id INTO _acc_salaires FROM public.gl_accounts WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND code='6610' LIMIT 1; SELECT id INTO _acc_charges FROM public.gl_accounts WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND code='6630' LIMIT 1; SELECT id INTO _acc_personnel FROM public.gl_accounts WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND code='4210' LIMIT 1; SELECT id INTO _acc_cnps FROM public.gl_accounts WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND code='4310' LIMIT 1; SELECT id INTO _acc_etat FROM public.gl_accounts WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND code='4470' LIMIT 1; IF _acc_salaires IS NULL OR _acc_personnel IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Comptes GL paie manquants (6610 Salaires / 4210 Personnel). Configurez le plan SYSCOHADA.'; END IF; _entry_number := 'JE-PAY-'||_r.period||'-'||substr(_run_id::text,1,8); INSERT INTO public.journal_entries(tenant_id, entry_number, entry_date, description, source, status, created_by) VALUES (_tenant, _entry_number, _r.pay_date, 'Paie '||_r.period, 'payroll', 'draft', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _entry_id; -- DR INSERT INTO public.journal_lines(entry_id, account_id, debit, credit, description) VALUES (_entry_id, _acc_salaires, _gross + CASE WHEN _acc_charges IS NULL THEN _patronal ELSE 0 END, 0, 'DR Salaires bruts'); IF _acc_charges IS NOT NULL AND _patronal > 0 THEN INSERT INTO public.journal_lines(entry_id, account_id, debit, credit, description) VALUES (_entry_id, _acc_charges, _patronal, 0, 'DR Charges patronales'); END IF; -- CR Personnel INSERT INTO public.journal_lines(entry_id, account_id, debit, credit, description) VALUES (_entry_id, _acc_personnel, 0, _net, 'CR Personnel — rémunérations dues'); -- CR CNPS — fallback vers Personnel si compte absent IF (_ded + _patronal) > 0 THEN IF _acc_cnps IS NOT NULL THEN INSERT INTO public.journal_lines(entry_id, account_id, debit, credit, description) VALUES (_entry_id, _acc_cnps, 0, _ded + _patronal, 'CR Organismes sociaux (CNPS)'); ELSE UPDATE public.journal_lines SET credit = credit + (_ded + _patronal) WHERE entry_id=_entry_id AND account_id=_acc_personnel; END IF; END IF; -- CR État — fallback vers Personnel si compte absent IF _tax > 0 THEN IF _acc_etat IS NOT NULL THEN INSERT INTO public.journal_lines(entry_id, account_id, debit, credit, description) VALUES (_entry_id, _acc_etat, 0, _tax, 'CR État — impôt sur salaires'); ELSE UPDATE public.journal_lines SET credit = credit + _tax WHERE entry_id=_entry_id AND account_id=_acc_personnel; END IF; END IF; UPDATE public.journal_entries SET status='posted', posted_by=auth.uid(), posted_at=now() WHERE id=_entry_id; UPDATE public.payroll_runs SET status='posted', executed_by=auth.uid(), executed_at=now(), notes = COALESCE(notes,'')||' | JE='||_entry_number WHERE id=_run_id; RETURN _entry_id; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_posted_entry() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status = 'posted' AND NEW.status NOT IN ('posted','reversed','cancelled') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'JE %: a posted entry can only be reversed or cancelled', OLD.entry_number; END IF; IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND OLD.status = 'posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'JE %: posted entries cannot be deleted (use reversal)', OLD.entry_number; END IF; RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_posted_lines() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _status text; BEGIN SELECT status INTO _status FROM public.journal_entries WHERE id = COALESCE(NEW.entry_id, OLD.entry_id); IF _status = 'posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot modify lines of a posted journal entry'; END IF; RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_ap_invoice_from_payment() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _inv_id uuid; _total numeric; _paid numeric; _due date; BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN IF OLD.payment_type <> 'ap_payment' OR OLD.ap_invoice_id IS NULL THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; _inv_id := OLD.ap_invoice_id; ELSE IF NEW.payment_type <> 'ap_payment' OR NEW.ap_invoice_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; _inv_id := NEW.ap_invoice_id; END IF; SELECT total, due_date INTO _total, _due FROM public.ap_invoices WHERE id = _inv_id; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) INTO _paid FROM public.payments WHERE ap_invoice_id = _inv_id AND payment_type = 'ap_payment'; UPDATE public.ap_invoices SET amount_paid = _paid, status = CASE WHEN _paid >= _total THEN 'paid' WHEN _paid > 0 THEN 'partially_paid' WHEN _due IS NOT NULL AND _due < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue' ELSE status END WHERE id = _inv_id; RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_ar_invoice_from_payment() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _inv_id uuid; _total numeric; _paid numeric; _due date; BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN IF OLD.payment_type <> 'ar_receipt' OR OLD.ar_invoice_id IS NULL THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; _inv_id := OLD.ar_invoice_id; ELSE IF NEW.payment_type <> 'ar_receipt' OR NEW.ar_invoice_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; _inv_id := NEW.ar_invoice_id; END IF; SELECT total, due_date INTO _total, _due FROM public.ar_invoices WHERE id = _inv_id; SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) INTO _paid FROM public.payments WHERE ar_invoice_id = _inv_id AND payment_type = 'ar_receipt'; UPDATE public.ar_invoices SET amount_paid = _paid, status = CASE WHEN _paid >= _total THEN 'paid' WHEN _paid > 0 THEN 'partially_paid' WHEN _due IS NOT NULL AND _due < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue' ELSE status END WHERE id = _inv_id; RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_po_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _po uuid; BEGIN _po := COALESCE(NEW.po_id, OLD.po_id); UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET total = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM public.po_lines WHERE po_id = _po) WHERE id = _po; RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_pr_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _pr uuid; BEGIN _pr := COALESCE(NEW.requisition_id, OLD.requisition_id); UPDATE public.purchase_requisitions SET estimated_total = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM public.requisition_lines WHERE requisition_id = _pr) WHERE id = _pr; RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_quote_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _q uuid; BEGIN _q := COALESCE(NEW.quotation_id, OLD.quotation_id); UPDATE public.quotations SET total=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM public.quote_lines WHERE quotation_id=_q) WHERE id=_q; RETURN COALESCE(NEW,OLD); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_so_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _s uuid; BEGIN _s := COALESCE(NEW.so_id, OLD.so_id); UPDATE public.sales_orders SET total=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM public.so_lines WHERE so_id=_s) WHERE id=_s; RETURN COALESCE(NEW,OLD); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_match_decision(_po_id uuid, _decision text, _reason text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _id uuid; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _po_tenant uuid; _po_number text; BEGIN IF NOT public.has_procurement_perm(auth.uid(), '3wm') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: 3WM decisions require Controller or 3WM Approver role'; END IF; IF _decision NOT IN ('accepted','revision_requested') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid decision'; END IF; IF _reason IS NULL OR length(trim(_reason))=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reason required'; END IF; SELECT tenant_id, po_number INTO _po_tenant, _po_number FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=_po_id; IF _po_tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PO not found'; END IF; IF _po_tenant <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.procurement_match_decisions (tenant_id, po_id, decision, reason, decided_by) VALUES (_tenant, _po_id, _decision, _reason, auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _id; PERFORM public.notify_procurement(_tenant, CASE WHEN _decision='accepted' THEN 'success' ELSE 'warning' END, '3WM ' || _decision || ' — ' || _po_number, _reason, _po_id::text); RETURN _id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_procurement_step(_approval_id uuid, _comment text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _a public.procurement_approvals%ROWTYPE; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _perm text; BEGIN SELECT * INTO _a FROM public.procurement_approvals WHERE id = _approval_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Approval not found'; END IF; IF _a.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; IF _a.status <> 'pending' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Already decided'; END IF; IF _comment IS NULL OR length(trim(_comment))=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Comment required for rejection'; END IF; _perm := 'approve_l' || _a.level_order::text; IF _a.level_order > 3 THEN _perm := 'approve_l3'; END IF; IF NOT public.has_procurement_perm(auth.uid(), _perm) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: requires role for %', _a.level_label; END IF; UPDATE public.procurement_approvals SET status='rejected', decided_by=auth.uid(), decided_at=now(), comment=_comment WHERE id=_approval_id; UPDATE public.procurement_approvals SET status='skipped', decided_at=now() WHERE doc_type=_a.doc_type AND doc_id=_a.doc_id AND status='pending'; IF _a.doc_type='PR' THEN UPDATE public.purchase_requisitions SET status='rejected' WHERE id=_a.doc_id; ELSE UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET status='rejected' WHERE id=_a.doc_id; END IF; PERFORM public.notify_procurement(_a.tenant_id, 'critical', _a.doc_type || ' rejetée', 'Motif: ' || _comment, _a.doc_id::text); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reopen_gl_period(_period text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN IF _tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No tenant'; END IF; IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only administrators can reopen GL periods'; END IF; UPDATE public.period_locks SET status = 'open', closed_by = NULL, closed_at = NULL WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND module = 'GL' AND period = _period; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_all_erp_alerts(_module text DEFAULT NULL::text, _severity text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE v_tenant uuid; v_count integer; BEGIN SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid(); IF v_tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No tenant'; END IF; -- Restrict bulk resolve to admins IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin role required'; END IF; UPDATE public.erp_alerts SET is_resolved = true, resolved_at = now(), resolved_by = auth.uid() WHERE tenant_id = v_tenant AND is_resolved = false AND (_module IS NULL OR module = _module) AND (_severity IS NULL OR severity = _severity); GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT; RETURN v_count; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_erp_alert(_alert_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE v_tenant uuid; BEGIN SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant FROM public.erp_alerts WHERE id = _alert_id; IF v_tenant IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_role_assignments WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND tenant_id = v_tenant ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF; UPDATE public.erp_alerts SET is_resolved = true, resolved_at = now(), resolved_by = auth.uid()::text WHERE id = _alert_id; RETURN true; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_journal_entry(_entry_id uuid, _reverse_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE, _reason text DEFAULT 'Contre-passation'::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _src public.journal_entries%ROWTYPE; _new_id uuid; _new_number text; _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); BEGIN SELECT * INTO _src FROM public.journal_entries WHERE id = _entry_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Entry not found'; END IF; IF _src.tenant_id <> _tenant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant mismatch'; END IF; IF _src.status <> 'posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only posted entries can be reversed (status=%)', _src.status; END IF; _new_number := 'REV-' || _src.entry_number || '-' || to_char(now(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'); INSERT INTO public.journal_entries (tenant_id, entry_number, entry_date, description, source, status, created_by) VALUES (_src.tenant_id, _new_number, _reverse_date, 'Reversal of '||_src.entry_number||' — '||COALESCE(_reason,''), 'reversal', 'draft', auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO _new_id; INSERT INTO public.journal_lines (entry_id, account_id, debit, credit, description) SELECT _new_id, jl.account_id, jl.credit, jl.debit, 'Reversal: '||COALESCE(jl.description,'') FROM public.journal_lines jl WHERE jl.entry_id = _src.id; UPDATE public.journal_entries SET status='posted', posted_by=auth.uid(), posted_at=now() WHERE id = _new_id; UPDATE public.journal_entries SET status='reversed' WHERE id = _src.id; RETURN _new_id; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_ap_defaults(_tenant_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN INSERT INTO public.ap_general_settings(tenant_id) VALUES (_tenant_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO public.ap_numbering_series(tenant_id, doc_type, prefix, format) VALUES (_tenant_id, 'Supplier Invoice', 'APINV-', 'APINV-YYYY-####'), (_tenant_id, 'Credit Note', 'APCN-', 'APCN-YYYY-####'), (_tenant_id, 'Payment', 'APPAY-', 'APPAY-YYYY-####') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO public.ap_payment_methods(tenant_id, code, label, is_default, is_active) VALUES (_tenant_id, 'WIRE', 'Virement bancaire', true, true), (_tenant_id, 'CHECK', 'Chèque', false, true), (_tenant_id, 'LC', 'Lettre de crédit', false, true), (_tenant_id, 'CASH', 'Espèces', false, false) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO public.ap_withholding_rates(tenant_id, category, rate_pct, gl_account, is_active) VALUES (_tenant_id, 'Services (BIC)', 7.5, '4471', true), (_tenant_id, 'Loyers', 15, '4472', true), (_tenant_id, 'Non-résidents', 20, '4473', true), (_tenant_id, 'Dividendes', 10, '4474', false); INSERT INTO public.ap_notification_rules(tenant_id, event, channel, recipients) VALUES (_tenant_id, 'Facture en attente > 48h', 'email', 'AP Manager'), (_tenant_id, 'Échéance dans 3 jours', 'email,inapp', 'AP Clerk, Treasury'), (_tenant_id, 'Paiement > 50M XOF', 'inapp', 'CFO'), (_tenant_id, 'Échec 3-way match', 'email', 'AP Manager'); INSERT INTO public.ap_approval_thresholds(tenant_id, level, max_amount, approver, sla_hours, doc_types) VALUES (_tenant_id, 'L1 — Clerk', 5000000, 'AP Clerk', 4, 'Facture, Avoir'), (_tenant_id, 'L2 — Manager', 20000000, 'AP Manager', 24, 'Facture, Paiement'), (_tenant_id, 'L3 — Director', 50000000, 'Finance Director', 48, 'Paiement, Contrat'), (_tenant_id, 'L4 — CFO', NULL, 'CFO', 72, 'Tous au-dessus du seuil') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_procurement_approval_queue() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _doc_type text; _amount numeric; _t public.procurement_approval_thresholds%ROWTYPE; _order int := 1; BEGIN IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'purchase_requisitions' THEN _doc_type := 'PR'; _amount := COALESCE(NEW.estimated_total, 0); ELSE _doc_type := 'PO'; _amount := COALESCE(NEW.total, 0); END IF; -- Only seed when entering pending_approval and queue empty IF NEW.status <> 'pending_approval' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.procurement_approvals WHERE doc_type=_doc_type AND doc_id=NEW.id) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; FOR _t IN SELECT * FROM public.procurement_approval_thresholds WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND doc_type = _doc_type ORDER BY max_amount NULLS LAST LOOP INSERT INTO public.procurement_approvals (tenant_id, doc_type, doc_id, level_order, level_label, approver_role, sla_hours, sla_due_at, amount) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, _doc_type, NEW.id, _order, _t.level, _t.approver, _t.sla_hours, now() + (_t.sla_hours || ' hours')::interval, _amount); _order := _order + 1; -- Stop at the threshold that covers the amount (NULL = top tier) IF _t.max_amount IS NULL OR _amount <= _t.max_amount THEN EXIT; END IF; END LOOP; PERFORM public.notify_procurement( NEW.tenant_id, 'info', _doc_type || ' assignée pour approbation', 'Document ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN _doc_type='PR' THEN NEW.pr_number ELSE NEW.po_number END,'') || ' en file d''attente.', NEW.id::text); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.suggest_bank_matches(p_line_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(transaction_id uuid, transaction_date date, description text, amount numeric, score numeric) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE v_tenant uuid; v_account uuid; v_amount numeric; v_date date; v_tol numeric := 0; v_window int := 3; BEGIN SELECT l.tenant_id, s.bank_account_id, l.amount, l.line_date INTO v_tenant, v_account, v_amount, v_date FROM public.bank_statement_lines l JOIN public.bank_statements s ON s.id = l.statement_id WHERE l.id = p_line_id; IF v_tenant IS NULL OR v_tenant <> public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()) THEN RETURN; END IF; SELECT ts.match_amount_tolerance, ts.match_date_window_days INTO v_tol, v_window FROM public.treasury_settings ts WHERE ts.tenant_id = v_tenant; v_tol := COALESCE(v_tol, 0); v_window := COALESCE(v_window, 3); RETURN QUERY SELECT t.id, t.transaction_date, t.description, t.amount, (100 - LEAST(100, ABS(t.amount - v_amount)::numeric) - LEAST(50, ABS(t.transaction_date - v_date) * 5))::numeric AS score FROM public.bank_transactions t WHERE t.tenant_id = v_tenant AND t.bank_account_id = v_account AND t.is_reconciled = false AND ABS(t.amount - v_amount) <= GREATEST(v_tol, 0.01) AND ABS(t.transaction_date - v_date) <= v_window ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_notification_preferences() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_stock(_item_id uuid, _from_wh uuid, _to_wh uuid, _qty numeric, _notes text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ DECLARE _tenant uuid := public.get_user_tenant_id(auth.uid()); _avg numeric; BEGIN IF NOT public.has_inventory_perm(auth.uid(), 'transfer') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied'; END IF; IF _qty <= 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quantité doit être > 0'; END IF; IF _from_wh = _to_wh THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Entrepôts identiques'; END IF; SELECT average_cost INTO _avg FROM public.items WHERE id = _item_id; INSERT INTO public.stock_movements(tenant_id, item_id, movement_type, quantity, unit_cost, warehouse_id, reference_type, created_by, status) VALUES (_tenant, _item_id, 'transfer_out', -_qty, COALESCE(_avg,0), _from_wh, 'transfer', auth.uid(), 'posted'); INSERT INTO public.stock_movements(tenant_id, item_id, movement_type, quantity, unit_cost, warehouse_id, reference_type, created_by, status) VALUES (_tenant, _item_id, 'transfer_in', _qty, COALESCE(_avg,0), _to_wh, 'transfer', auth.uid(), 'posted'); PERFORM public.notify_inventory(_tenant, 'info', 'Transfert stock', _qty || ' unités déplacées', _item_id::text); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_bank_recon_validated() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF NEW.status = 'validated' AND (OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'validated') THEN UPDATE public.bank_accounts SET last_reconciled_at = NEW.period_end WHERE id = NEW.bank_account_id; NEW.validated_at := COALESCE(NEW.validated_at, now()); END IF; NEW.updated_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_bsl_match_sync() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN IF NEW.matched_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND (OLD.matched_transaction_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.matched_transaction_id) THEN UPDATE public.bank_transactions SET is_reconciled = true WHERE id = NEW.matched_transaction_id; NEW.matched_at := COALESCE(NEW.matched_at, now()); ELSIF NEW.matched_transaction_id IS NULL AND OLD.matched_transaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE public.bank_transactions SET is_reconciled = false WHERE id = OLD.matched_transaction_id; NEW.matched_at := NULL; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_ap_invoice() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.total := ROUND((COALESCE(NEW.subtotal,0) + COALESCE(NEW.tax_amount,0))::numeric, 2); IF NEW.amount_paid > NEW.total THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AP Invoice %: amount_paid (%) > total (%)', NEW.invoice_number, NEW.amount_paid, NEW.total; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_ar_invoice() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.total := ROUND((COALESCE(NEW.subtotal,0) + COALESCE(NEW.tax_amount,0))::numeric, 2); IF NEW.amount_paid > NEW.total THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AR Invoice %: amount_paid (%) > total (%)', NEW.invoice_number, NEW.amount_paid, NEW.total; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

column4: WITH sales AS ( SELECT dn.tenant_id, dnl.item_id, sum(dnl.total) AS revenue_12m FROM dn_lines dnl JOIN delivery_notes dn ON dn.id = dnl.dn_id WHERE dn.delivery_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '1 year'::interval) GROUP BY dn.tenant_id, dnl.item_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, s.item_id, s.revenue_12m, sum(s.revenue_12m) OVER (PARTITION BY s.tenant_id) AS total_rev, sum(s.revenue_12m) OVER (PARTITION BY s.tenant_id ORDER BY s.revenue_12m DESC) AS cum_rev FROM sales s ) SELECT tenant_id, item_id, revenue_12m, CASE WHEN cum_rev <= (total_rev * 0.8) THEN 'A'::text WHEN cum_rev <= (total_rev * 0.95) THEN 'B'::text ELSE 'C'::text END AS abc_class FROM ranked;

SELECT i.tenant_id, i.id AS invoice_id, i.invoice_number, i.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, i.invoice_date, i.due_date, i.total, i.amount_paid, GREATEST(i.total - i.amount_paid, 0::numeric) AS outstanding, GREATEST(CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date, 0) AS days_overdue, CASE WHEN i.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'current'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) <= 30 THEN '1-30'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90'::text ELSE '90+'::text END AS bucket, i.status, i.approval_status FROM ap_invoices i LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = i.supplier_id WHERE i.status <> 'paid'::text AND i.total > i.amount_paid;

SELECT i.tenant_id, i.id AS invoice_id, i.invoice_number, i.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, i.invoice_date, i.due_date, i.total, i.amount_paid, GREATEST(i.total - i.amount_paid, 0::numeric) AS outstanding, GREATEST(CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date, 0) AS days_overdue, CASE WHEN i.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'current'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) <= 30 THEN '1-30'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90'::text ELSE '90+'::text END AS bucket, i.status FROM ar_invoices i LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.status <> 'paid'::text AND i.total > i.amount_paid;

SELECT c.tenant_id, c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, COALESCE(c.credit_limit, 0::numeric) AS credit_limit, COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text]) THEN i.total - i.amount_paid ELSE 0::numeric END), 0::numeric) AS outstanding, COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN (i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN i.total - i.amount_paid ELSE 0::numeric END), 0::numeric) AS overdue, COALESCE(round(avg( CASE WHEN i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text]) THEN CURRENT_DATE - i.invoice_date ELSE NULL::integer END))::integer, 0) AS dso, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.credit_limit, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AND COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text]) THEN i.total - i.amount_paid ELSE 0::numeric END), 0::numeric) > c.credit_limit THEN 95 WHEN COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN (i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND i.due_date < (CURRENT_DATE - 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 80 WHEN COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN (i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND i.due_date < (CURRENT_DATE - 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 60 WHEN COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN (i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 40 ELSE 15 END AS risk_score FROM customers c LEFT JOIN ar_invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.tenant_id, c.id, c.name, c.credit_limit;

SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'in_service'::text) AS active_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'disposed'::text) AS disposed_count, COALESCE(sum(acquisition_cost) FILTER (WHERE status = 'in_service'::text), 0::numeric) AS gross_value, COALESCE(sum(accumulated_depreciation) FILTER (WHERE status = 'in_service'::text), 0::numeric) AS accumulated, COALESCE(sum(net_book_value) FILTER (WHERE status = 'in_service'::text), 0::numeric) AS net_book_value, COALESCE(( SELECT sum(d.amount) AS sum FROM depreciation_entries d JOIN assets a2 ON a2.id = d.asset_id WHERE a2.tenant_id = assets.tenant_id AND d.period_date >= date_trunc('year'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone)::date), 0::numeric) AS depreciation_ytd FROM assets GROUP BY tenant_id;

SELECT a.tenant_id, a.id AS asset_id, a.asset_code, a.name, c.name AS category_name, a.acquisition_date, a.acquisition_cost, a.accumulated_depreciation, a.net_book_value, a.salvage_value, a.depreciation_method, a.useful_life_months, a.status, a.location, a.assigned_to FROM assets a LEFT JOIN asset_categories c ON c.id = a.category_id;

SELECT a.tenant_id, a.id AS account_id, a.code AS account_code, a.name AS account_name, e.id AS entry_id, e.entry_number, e.entry_date, e.description AS entry_description, e.source, l.id AS line_id, l.debit, l.credit, l.description AS line_description, sum(l.debit - l.credit) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY e.entry_date, e.entry_number, l.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance FROM journal_lines l JOIN journal_entries e ON e.id = l.entry_id JOIN gl_accounts a ON a.id = l.account_id WHERE e.status = 'posted'::text;

SELECT je.tenant_id, to_char(je.entry_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS period, COALESCE(pl.status, 'open'::text) AS status, pl.closed_by, pl.closed_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE je.status = 'posted'::text) AS posted_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE je.status = 'draft'::text) AS draft_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE je.status = 'reversed'::text) AS reversed_count, COALESCE(sum(jl.debit) FILTER (WHERE je.status = 'posted'::text), 0::numeric) AS total_debit, COALESCE(sum(jl.credit) FILTER (WHERE je.status = 'posted'::text), 0::numeric) AS total_credit FROM journal_entries je LEFT JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.entry_id = je.id LEFT JOIN period_locks pl ON pl.tenant_id = je.tenant_id AND pl.module = 'GL'::text AND pl.period = to_char(je.entry_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) GROUP BY je.tenant_id, (to_char(je.entry_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text)), pl.status, pl.closed_by, pl.closed_at;

WITH base AS ( SELECT je.tenant_id, to_char(je.entry_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS period, "left"(a.code, 2) AS class2, "left"(a.code, 1) AS class1, sum(jl.debit) AS dr, sum(jl.credit) AS cr FROM journal_entries je JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.entry_id = je.id JOIN gl_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id WHERE je.status = 'posted'::text GROUP BY je.tenant_id, (to_char(je.entry_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text)), ("left"(a.code, 2)), ("left"(a.code, 1)) ), agg AS ( SELECT base.tenant_id, base.period, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = '70'::text THEN base.cr - base.dr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS ventes, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = ANY (ARRAY['71'::text, '72'::text]) THEN base.cr - base.dr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS production_stockee, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = '60'::text THEN base.dr - base.cr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS achats_consommes, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = ANY (ARRAY['61'::text, '62'::text]) THEN base.dr - base.cr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS services_ext, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = '63'::text THEN base.dr - base.cr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS impots_taxes, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = '64'::text THEN base.dr - base.cr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS charges_personnel, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = '68'::text THEN base.dr - base.cr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS dotations, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = ANY (ARRAY['65'::text, '75'::text]) THEN CASE WHEN base.class2 = '65'::text THEN base.dr - base.cr ELSE - (base.cr - base.dr) END ELSE 0::numeric END) AS autres_net, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = ANY (ARRAY['66'::text, '67'::text]) THEN base.dr - base.cr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS charges_fin_hao, sum( CASE WHEN base.class2 = ANY (ARRAY['77'::text, '78'::text]) THEN base.cr - base.dr ELSE 0::numeric END) AS produits_fin_reprises FROM base GROUP BY base.tenant_id, base.period ) SELECT tenant_id, period, ventes, production_stockee, achats_consommes, services_ext, impots_taxes, charges_personnel, dotations, ventes - achats_consommes AS marge_commerciale, ventes + production_stockee AS chiffre_affaires, ventes + production_stockee - achats_consommes - services_ext AS valeur_ajoutee, ventes + production_stockee - achats_consommes - services_ext - impots_taxes - charges_personnel AS ebe, ventes + production_stockee - achats_consommes - services_ext - impots_taxes - charges_personnel - dotations - autres_net AS resultat_exploitation, ventes + production_stockee - achats_consommes - services_ext - impots_taxes - charges_personnel - dotations - autres_net - charges_fin_hao + produits_fin_reprises AS resultat_net FROM agg;

SELECT a.tenant_id, a.id AS account_id, a.code, a.name, a.account_type, COALESCE(sum(l.debit), 0::numeric) AS total_debit, COALESCE(sum(l.credit), 0::numeric) AS total_credit, COALESCE(sum(l.debit - l.credit), 0::numeric) AS balance FROM gl_accounts a LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN journal_entries e ON e.id = l.entry_id AND e.status = 'posted'::text GROUP BY a.tenant_id, a.id, a.code, a.name, a.account_type;

WITH outbound AS ( SELECT sm.tenant_id, sm.item_id, sum(abs(sm.quantity) * COALESCE(sm.unit_cost, i.unit_cost, 0::numeric)) AS revenue_12m, sum(abs(sm.quantity)) AS qty_12m FROM stock_movements sm JOIN items i ON i.id = sm.item_id WHERE sm.movement_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '1 year'::interval) AND sm.quantity < 0::numeric AND (sm.movement_type <> ALL (ARRAY['transfer_in'::text, 'transfer_out'::text, 'transfer'::text, 'adjust_in'::text, 'adjust_out'::text])) GROUP BY sm.tenant_id, sm.item_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT o.tenant_id, o.item_id, o.revenue_12m, o.qty_12m, i.code, i.name, i.category, sum(o.revenue_12m) OVER (PARTITION BY o.tenant_id) AS total_rev, sum(o.revenue_12m) OVER (PARTITION BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY o.revenue_12m DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_rev FROM outbound o JOIN items i ON i.id = o.item_id ) SELECT tenant_id, item_id, code, name, category, revenue_12m, qty_12m, CASE WHEN total_rev = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric ELSE round(cum_rev / total_rev * 100::numeric, 2) END AS cum_pct, CASE WHEN total_rev = 0::numeric THEN 'C'::text WHEN (cum_rev / total_rev) <= 0.80 THEN 'A'::text WHEN (cum_rev / total_rev) <= 0.95 THEN 'B'::text ELSE 'C'::text END AS abc_class FROM ranked;

SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active'::text) AS active_items, count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity_on_hand <= COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock, 0::numeric), reorder_level, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock, 0::numeric), reorder_level, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric) AS low_stock_items, count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity_on_hand <= 0::numeric) AS out_of_stock_items, round(COALESCE(sum(quantity_on_hand * average_cost), 0::numeric), 2) AS total_stock_value FROM items i GROUP BY tenant_id;

SELECT tenant_id, id AS item_id, code, name, category, quantity_on_hand, COALESCE(average_cost, unit_cost, 0::numeric) AS unit_cost, quantity_on_hand * COALESCE(average_cost, unit_cost, 0::numeric) AS stock_value, ( SELECT max(sm.movement_date) AS max FROM stock_movements sm WHERE sm.item_id = i.id AND sm.quantity < 0::numeric AND (sm.movement_type <> ALL (ARRAY['transfer_in'::text, 'transfer_out'::text, 'transfer'::text, 'adjust_in'::text, 'adjust_out'::text]))) AS last_outbound_date, CASE WHEN (( SELECT max(sm.movement_date) AS max FROM stock_movements sm WHERE sm.item_id = i.id AND sm.quantity < 0::numeric)) IS NULL THEN 'Dormant'::text WHEN (( SELECT max(sm.movement_date) AS max FROM stock_movements sm WHERE sm.item_id = i.id AND sm.quantity < 0::numeric)) < (CURRENT_DATE - '180 days'::interval) THEN 'Mort'::text WHEN (( SELECT max(sm.movement_date) AS max FROM stock_movements sm WHERE sm.item_id = i.id AND sm.quantity < 0::numeric)) < (CURRENT_DATE - '90 days'::interval) THEN 'Lent'::text ELSE 'Actif'::text END AS movement_class FROM items i WHERE quantity_on_hand > 0::numeric AND status = 'active'::text;

WITH cogs AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text) AS category, sum(abs(m.quantity) * COALESCE(m.unit_cost, i.average_cost, i.unit_cost, 0::numeric)) AS cogs_12m FROM stock_movements m JOIN items i ON i.id = m.item_id WHERE m.quantity < 0::numeric AND m.movement_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '365 days'::interval) AND (m.movement_type <> ALL (ARRAY['transfer_in'::text, 'transfer_out'::text, 'transfer'::text])) GROUP BY i.tenant_id, (COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text)) ), inv AS ( SELECT items.tenant_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(items.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text) AS category, sum(items.quantity_on_hand * COALESCE(items.average_cost, items.unit_cost, 0::numeric)) AS inv_value FROM items WHERE items.status = 'active'::text GROUP BY items.tenant_id, (COALESCE(NULLIF(items.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text)) ) SELECT inv.tenant_id, inv.category, inv.inv_value, COALESCE(c.cogs_12m, 0::numeric) AS cogs_12m, CASE WHEN inv.inv_value > 0::numeric THEN round(COALESCE(c.cogs_12m, 0::numeric) / inv.inv_value, 2) ELSE 0::numeric END AS turnover_ratio, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.cogs_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN round(365.0 * inv.inv_value / c.cogs_12m, 0) ELSE NULL::numeric END AS days_on_hand FROM inv LEFT JOIN cogs c ON c.tenant_id = inv.tenant_id AND c.category = inv.category;

WITH fifo AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text) AS category, sum(l.qty_remaining * l.cost_in) AS fifo_value FROM items i LEFT JOIN stock_valuation_layers l ON l.item_id = i.id GROUP BY i.tenant_id, (COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text)) ), avgc AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text) AS category, count(*) AS items_count, sum(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty, sum(i.quantity_on_hand * COALESCE(i.average_cost, i.unit_cost, 0::numeric)) AS avg_cost_value FROM items i WHERE i.status = 'active'::text GROUP BY i.tenant_id, (COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category, ''::text), 'Sans catégorie'::text)) ) SELECT a.tenant_id, a.category, a.items_count, a.total_qty, COALESCE(f.fifo_value, 0::numeric) AS fifo_value, a.avg_cost_value, COALESCE(f.fifo_value, 0::numeric) - a.avg_cost_value AS variance FROM avgc a LEFT JOIN fifo f ON f.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND f.category = a.category;

SELECT c.id AS count_id, c.tenant_id, c.count_number, c.count_date, c.status, w.code AS warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, count(l.id) AS items_checked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(l.variance, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric) AS items_matched, count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(l.variance, 0::numeric) <> 0::numeric) AS items_variance, COALESCE(sum(l.variance_value), 0::numeric) AS total_value_diff FROM inventory_counts c LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = c.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN inventory_count_lines l ON l.count_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.tenant_id, c.count_number, c.count_date, c.status, w.code, w.name;

SELECT tenant_id, id AS item_id, code, name, unit, quantity_on_hand, COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock, 0::numeric), reorder_level, 0::numeric) AS threshold, COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock, 0::numeric), reorder_level, 0::numeric) - quantity_on_hand AS gap FROM items i WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock, 0::numeric), reorder_level, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AND quantity_on_hand <= COALESCE(NULLIF(safety_stock, 0::numeric), reorder_level, 0::numeric);

SELECT tenant_id, to_char(CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY'::text) AS fiscal_year, COALESCE(sum(gross_total) FILTER (WHERE period ~~ (to_char(CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY'::text) || '%'::text) AND status = 'posted'::text), 0::numeric) AS gross_ytd, COALESCE(sum(net_total) FILTER (WHERE period ~~ (to_char(CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY'::text) || '%'::text) AND status = 'posted'::text), 0::numeric) AS net_ytd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'posted'::text) AS posted_runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'draft'::text) AS draft_runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'::text) AS approved_runs, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM employees e WHERE e.tenant_id = pr.tenant_id AND e.status = 'active'::text) AS active_employees FROM payroll_runs pr GROUP BY tenant_id;

SELECT pl.tenant_id, pr.period, pr.pay_date, pr.status, e.matricule, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.department, e.job_title, pl.gross, pl.deductions, pl.taxes, pl.net FROM payroll_lines pl JOIN payroll_runs pr ON pr.id = pl.run_id JOIN employees e ON e.id = pl.employee_id;

SELECT tenant_id, id AS po_id, po_number, status AS po_status, total AS po_total, COALESCE(( SELECT sum(grl.quantity_received * pl.unit_cost) AS sum FROM goods_receipts gr JOIN gr_lines grl ON grl.gr_id = gr.id LEFT JOIN po_lines pl ON pl.id = grl.po_line_id WHERE gr.po_id = po.id AND gr.status = 'completed'::text), 0::numeric) AS gr_total, COALESCE(( SELECT sum(api.total) AS sum FROM ap_invoices api WHERE api.supplier_id = po.supplier_id AND api.invoice_date >= po.order_date AND api.invoice_date <= (po.order_date + '90 days'::interval)), 0::numeric) AS ap_total_window, CASE WHEN total = 0::numeric THEN 'no_po'::text WHEN abs(total - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(grl.quantity_received * pl.unit_cost) AS sum FROM goods_receipts gr JOIN gr_lines grl ON grl.gr_id = gr.id LEFT JOIN po_lines pl ON pl.id = grl.po_line_id WHERE gr.po_id = po.id AND gr.status = 'completed'::text), 0::numeric)) < 1::numeric THEN 'matched'::text ELSE 'variance'::text END AS match_status FROM purchase_orders po;

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, COALESCE(a.decided_at, a.created_at) AS event_at, CASE a.status WHEN 'pending'::text THEN 'approval_assigned'::text WHEN 'approved'::text THEN 'approval_approved'::text WHEN 'rejected'::text THEN 'approval_rejected'::text WHEN 'skipped'::text THEN 'approval_skipped'::text ELSE NULL::text END AS event_type, a.doc_type, a.doc_id, CASE WHEN a.doc_type = 'PR'::text THEN pr.pr_number ELSE po.po_number END AS doc_number, a.level_label, a.amount, COALESCE(a.decided_by::text, ''::text) AS actor_id, COALESCE(p.full_name, a.approver_role) AS actor_name, a.comment FROM procurement_approvals a LEFT JOIN purchase_requisitions pr ON pr.id = a.doc_id AND a.doc_type = 'PR'::text LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = a.doc_id AND a.doc_type = 'PO'::text LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = a.decided_by UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id, d.created_at AS event_at, 'match_'::text || d.decision AS event_type, 'PO'::text AS doc_type, d.po_id AS doc_id, po.po_number AS doc_number, '3-Way Match'::text AS level_label, po.total AS amount, COALESCE(d.decided_by::text, ''::text) AS actor_id, COALESCE(p.full_name, '—'::text) AS actor_name, d.reason AS comment FROM procurement_match_decisions d JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = d.po_id LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = d.decided_by UNION ALL SELECT pr.id, pr.tenant_id, COALESCE(pr.approved_at, pr.created_at) AS event_at, 'pr_converted_to_po'::text AS event_type, 'PR'::text AS doc_type, pr.id AS doc_id, (pr.pr_number || ' → '::text) || COALESCE(po.po_number, '?'::text) AS doc_number, 'Conversion'::text AS level_label, COALESCE(pr.estimated_total, 0::numeric) AS amount, COALESCE(pr.approved_by::text, ''::text) AS actor_id, COALESCE(p.full_name, '—'::text) AS actor_name, NULL::text AS comment FROM purchase_requisitions pr LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.id = pr.po_id LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = pr.approved_by WHERE pr.po_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT id AS tenant_id, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM purchase_requisitions WHERE purchase_requisitions.tenant_id = t.id AND (purchase_requisitions.status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'pending_approval'::text]))) AS pr_open, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM purchase_orders WHERE purchase_orders.tenant_id = t.id AND (purchase_orders.status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'pending_approval'::text]))) AS po_pending, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM goods_receipts WHERE goods_receipts.tenant_id = t.id AND goods_receipts.receipt_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS gr_today, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM three_way_match_view WHERE three_way_match_view.tenant_id = t.id AND three_way_match_view.match_status = 'discrepancy'::text) AS tw_discrepancies, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(purchase_orders.total), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM purchase_orders WHERE purchase_orders.tenant_id = t.id AND purchase_orders.status = 'approved'::text AND purchase_orders.order_date >= date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone)) AS po_value_mtd FROM tenants t;

SELECT po.id AS po_id, po.tenant_id, po.po_number, pr.pr_number, pr.request_date AS pr_date, pr.approved_at AS pr_approved_at, po.order_date AS po_date, ( SELECT min(gr.receipt_date) AS min FROM goods_receipts gr WHERE gr.po_id = po.id AND gr.status = 'completed'::text) AS gr_date, ( SELECT min(ap.invoice_date) AS min FROM ap_invoices ap WHERE ap.po_id = po.id) AS ap_date, EXTRACT(epoch FROM pr.approved_at - pr.request_date::timestamp without time zone::timestamp with time zone) / 3600::numeric AS pr_cycle_hours, EXTRACT(epoch FROM po.order_date::timestamp without time zone::timestamp with time zone - pr.approved_at) / 3600::numeric AS pr_to_po_hours, EXTRACT(epoch FROM (( SELECT min(gr.receipt_date) AS min FROM goods_receipts gr WHERE gr.po_id = po.id AND gr.status = 'completed'::text))::timestamp without time zone - po.order_date::timestamp without time zone) / 24::numeric AS po_to_gr_days, EXTRACT(epoch FROM (( SELECT min(ap.invoice_date) AS min FROM ap_invoices ap WHERE ap.po_id = po.id))::timestamp without time zone - (( SELECT min(gr.receipt_date) AS min FROM goods_receipts gr WHERE gr.po_id = po.id AND gr.status = 'completed'::text))::timestamp without time zone) / 24::numeric AS gr_to_ap_days, po.status AS po_status, pr.status AS pr_status FROM purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN purchase_requisitions pr ON pr.po_id = po.id;
SELECT tenant_id, created_at, 'role_change'::text AS event_type, action, role::text AS detail, performed_by AS actor, target_user_id::text AS target, comment FROM sales_role_audit;

SELECT so.tenant_id, q.id AS quote_id, q.quote_number, q.status AS quote_status, q.total AS quote_total, so.id AS so_id, so.so_number, so.status AS so_status, so.total AS so_total, so.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, ari.id AS ar_invoice_id, ari.invoice_number, ari.total AS invoice_total, ari.status AS invoice_status FROM sales_orders so LEFT JOIN quotations q ON q.id = so.quotation_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = so.customer_id LEFT JOIN ar_invoices ari ON ari.customer_id = so.customer_id AND ari.invoice_date >= so.order_date AND ari.invoice_date <= (so.order_date + '30 days'::interval);

SELECT id AS tenant_id, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(a.total), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM ar_invoices a WHERE a.tenant_id = t.id AND a.invoice_date >= date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone)) AS revenue_mtd, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(s.total), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM sales_orders s WHERE s.tenant_id = t.id AND (s.status = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed'::text, 'partially_delivered'::text]))) AS backlog, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM quotations q WHERE q.tenant_id = t.id AND q.status = 'sent'::text) AS open_quotes, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM sales_orders s WHERE s.tenant_id = t.id AND s.status = 'confirmed'::text) AS open_sos FROM tenants t;

SELECT quotations.tenant_id, 'quote'::text AS stage, count(*) AS docs, COALESCE(sum(quotations.total), 0::numeric) AS amount FROM quotations WHERE quotations.status <> ALL (ARRAY['converted'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'expired'::text]) GROUP BY quotations.tenant_id UNION ALL SELECT sales_orders.tenant_id, 'sales_order'::text AS stage, count(*) AS docs, COALESCE(sum(sales_orders.total), 0::numeric) AS amount FROM sales_orders WHERE sales_orders.status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'partially_delivered'::text]) GROUP BY sales_orders.tenant_id UNION ALL SELECT delivery_notes.tenant_id, 'delivered'::text AS stage, count(*) AS docs, 0::numeric AS amount FROM delivery_notes WHERE delivery_notes.status = 'completed'::text GROUP BY delivery_notes.tenant_id UNION ALL SELECT ar_invoices.tenant_id, 'invoiced'::text AS stage, count(*) AS docs, COALESCE(sum(ar_invoices.total), 0::numeric) AS amount FROM ar_invoices WHERE ar_invoices.so_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ar_invoices.tenant_id;

SELECT s.tenant_id, s.id AS so_id, s.so_number, s.customer_id, s.order_date, q.quote_date, EXTRACT(epoch FROM s.created_at - q.created_at) / 3600::numeric AS quote_to_so_hours, ( SELECT min(dn.delivery_date) - s.order_date FROM delivery_notes dn WHERE dn.so_id = s.id) AS so_to_dn_days, ( SELECT min(ar.invoice_date) - min(dn.delivery_date) FROM delivery_notes dn LEFT JOIN ar_invoices ar ON ar.dn_id = dn.id WHERE dn.so_id = s.id) AS dn_to_invoice_days, s.status FROM sales_orders s LEFT JOIN quotations q ON q.id = s.quotation_id;

SELECT tenant_id, CASE WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - layer_date) <= 30 THEN '0-30 jours'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - layer_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60 jours'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - layer_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90 jours'::text ELSE '90+ jours'::text END AS age_bucket, sum(qty_remaining * cost_in) AS stock_value, sum(qty_remaining) AS qty_remaining, count(DISTINCT item_id) AS items_count FROM stock_valuation_layers l WHERE qty_remaining > 0::numeric GROUP BY tenant_id, ( CASE WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - layer_date) <= 30 THEN '0-30 jours'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - layer_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60 jours'::text WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - layer_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90 jours'::text ELSE '90+ jours'::text END);

SELECT sm.id, sm.tenant_id, sm.movement_date, sm.movement_type, sm.quantity, sm.unit_cost, sm.total_value, sm.reference_type, sm.reference_id, sm.warehouse_id, w.code AS warehouse_code, sm.item_id, i.code AS item_code, i.name AS item_name, sm.journal_entry_id, je.entry_number, sm.created_by, sm.created_at, sm.status FROM stock_movements sm LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = sm.item_id LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = sm.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = sm.journal_entry_id;

SELECT i.tenant_id, i.id AS item_id, i.code, i.name, i.unit, COALESCE(il.warehouse_id, i.default_warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, w.code AS warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(il.quantity_on_hand, i.quantity_on_hand) AS quantity_on_hand, i.average_cost, round(COALESCE(il.quantity_on_hand, i.quantity_on_hand) * COALESCE(i.average_cost, 0::numeric), 2) AS stock_value FROM items i LEFT JOIN item_locations il ON il.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = COALESCE(il.warehouse_id, i.default_warehouse_id);

WITH gr_agg AS ( SELECT gr.po_id, gr.tenant_id, COALESCE(sum(grl.quantity_received * pol.unit_cost), 0::numeric) AS received_value, COALESCE(sum(grl.quantity_received), 0::numeric) AS qty_received FROM goods_receipts gr JOIN gr_lines grl ON grl.gr_id = gr.id LEFT JOIN po_lines pol ON pol.id = grl.po_line_id WHERE gr.status = 'completed'::text GROUP BY gr.po_id, gr.tenant_id ), ap_agg AS ( SELECT ap_invoices.po_id, ap_invoices.tenant_id, COALESCE(sum(ap_invoices.subtotal), 0::numeric) AS invoiced_value, count(*) AS invoice_count FROM ap_invoices WHERE ap_invoices.po_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ap_invoices.po_id, ap_invoices.tenant_id ) SELECT po.id AS po_id, po.tenant_id, po.po_number, po.order_date, po.status AS po_status, s.name AS supplier_name, po.total AS po_total, COALESCE(g.received_value, 0::numeric) AS gr_value, COALESCE(g.qty_received, 0::numeric) AS gr_qty, COALESCE(a.invoiced_value, 0::numeric) AS ap_value, COALESCE(a.invoice_count, 0::bigint) AS ap_invoice_count, po.total - COALESCE(g.received_value, 0::numeric) AS po_vs_gr_diff, COALESCE(g.received_value, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(a.invoiced_value, 0::numeric) AS gr_vs_ap_diff, CASE WHEN COALESCE(g.received_value, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric AND COALESCE(a.invoiced_value, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric THEN 'pending'::text WHEN abs(po.total - COALESCE(g.received_value, 0::numeric)) <= GREATEST(ps.three_way_tolerance_amount, po.total * ps.three_way_tolerance_pct / 100::numeric) AND abs(COALESCE(g.received_value, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(a.invoiced_value, 0::numeric)) <= GREATEST(ps.three_way_tolerance_amount, po.total * ps.three_way_tolerance_pct / 100::numeric) THEN 'matched'::text ELSE 'discrepancy'::text END AS match_status FROM purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = po.supplier_id LEFT JOIN gr_agg g ON g.po_id = po.id LEFT JOIN ap_agg a ON a.po_id = po.id LEFT JOIN procurement_settings ps ON ps.tenant_id = po.tenant_id;

WITH weeks AS ( SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone)::date + w_1.w * 7 AS week_start, w_1.w AS week_index FROM generate_series(0, 12) w_1(w) ), ar AS ( SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, i.due_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS week_start, i.tenant_id, sum(i.total - COALESCE(i.amount_paid, 0::numeric)) AS amount FROM ar_invoices i WHERE (i.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'overdue'::text, 'sent'::text, 'partial'::text])) AND i.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND i.due_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 91) GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, i.due_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), i.tenant_id ), ap AS ( SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, i.due_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS week_start, i.tenant_id, sum(i.total - COALESCE(i.amount_paid, 0::numeric)) AS amount FROM ap_invoices i WHERE (i.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'overdue'::text, 'approved'::text, 'partial'::text])) AND i.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND i.due_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 91) GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, i.due_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), i.tenant_id ), manual_in AS ( SELECT f.week_start, f.tenant_id, sum(f.amount_forecast) AS amount FROM cashflow_forecasts f WHERE f.direction = 'inflow'::text GROUP BY f.week_start, f.tenant_id ), manual_out AS ( SELECT f.week_start, f.tenant_id, sum(f.amount_forecast) AS amount FROM cashflow_forecasts f WHERE f.direction = 'outflow'::text GROUP BY f.week_start, f.tenant_id ), tenants AS ( SELECT DISTINCT bank_accounts.tenant_id FROM bank_accounts ) SELECT t.tenant_id, w.week_start, w.week_index, COALESCE(ar.amount, 0::numeric) AS inflow_ar, COALESCE(mi.amount, 0::numeric) AS inflow_manual, COALESCE(ap.amount, 0::numeric) AS outflow_ap, COALESCE(mo.amount, 0::numeric) AS outflow_manual, COALESCE(ar.amount, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mi.amount, 0::numeric) - (COALESCE(ap.amount, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mo.amount, 0::numeric)) AS net_flow FROM tenants t CROSS JOIN weeks w LEFT JOIN ar ON ar.week_start = w.week_start AND ar.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ap ON ap.week_start = w.week_start AND ap.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN manual_in mi ON mi.week_start = w.week_start AND mi.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN manual_out mo ON mo.week_start = w.week_start AND mo.tenant_id = t.tenant_id;

SELECT a.tenant_id, a.id AS bank_account_id, a.name, a.bank_name, a.currency, a.balance AS current_balance, COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN t.transaction_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) THEN t.amount ELSE NULL::numeric END), 0::numeric) AS net_7d, COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN t.transaction_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 30) THEN t.amount ELSE NULL::numeric END), 0::numeric) AS net_30d, a.last_reconciled_at FROM bank_accounts a LEFT JOIN bank_transactions t ON t.bank_account_id = a.id WHERE a.is_active = true GROUP BY a.id;

SELECT c.id, c.tenant_id, c.period, c.status, c.attempt, c.total_balance, c.accounts_count, c.reconciliations_count, c.error_message, c.closed_by, c.closed_at, c.created_at, p.full_name AS closed_by_name FROM treasury_period_closes c LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = c.closed_by;

SELECT a.tenant_id, a.id AS bank_account_id, a.name, count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.is_reconciled = false) AS unreconciled_count, count(t.id) AS total_count, CASE WHEN count(t.id) > 0 THEN round(100.0 * count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.is_reconciled)::numeric / count(t.id)::numeric, 1) ELSE 100::numeric END AS reconciled_pct, max( CASE WHEN t.is_reconciled = false THEN CURRENT_DATE - t.transaction_date ELSE NULL::integer END) AS oldest_unreconciled_days, a.last_reconciled_at FROM bank_accounts a LEFT JOIN bank_transactions t ON t.bank_account_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id;
